description: This file declares an interface class 'IDataReader' within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace, which provides a pure virtual method 'readData' returning a vector of media segments. It includes licensing information, include guards, and a dependency on 'IMediaPipeline.h'.

classes.name: IDataReader
classes.description: An interface class defining a contract for reading media data, with a method 'readData' that returns a vector of media segments.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: A pure virtual method that, when implemented, reads and returns a vector of media segments.
